claims.content: To capture and store the details of an MSIU Salesman in the system to enable tracking of distribution transactions and sales performance.

claims.content: The need to add a new salesperson to the system for tracking distribution transactions and performance.

trigger.raw_text: The need to add a new salesperson to the system for tracking distribution transactions and performance.

claims.content: On capture of any duplicate name the system will give a warning message to have the duplicate name or to change the name.
For better reporting purposes it is better to have a differentiating indicator on the name.

If the system detects a duplicate Salesman Code or Name during entry, it displays a warning message. The user must either choose to proceed with the duplicate name (by selecting 'Yes' if prompted) or cancel/change the name to save the record. If the user chooses not to resolve the duplication, the new entry is not saved.
If any mandatory field (marked with *) is left blank during the registration process, the system prevents the record from being saved and prompts the user to complete the required information.
The system has successfully captured and stored the details of the MSIU Salesman in the Sales Team Master.
The new salesperson record is available for selection by users during distribution transactions to link vouchers sold to specific sales personnel.
The system can now track the performance of the registered salesman based on the number of vouchers sold and distribution activities recorded under their name.
If a duplicate name was entered and accepted, the system has flagged or noted the entry with a differentiating indicator as per design constraints for reporting purposes.
